verdict.rationale: Pylon's Support Agent ships with a default persona whose settings can be tuned to shape behavior (pylon-docs-57). Natural-language runbooks and reusable skills give operators instruction-level control and workflow consistency (pylon-docs-15, pylon-docs-20). QA rubrics can check that guidelines are followed (pylon-docs-74), but nothing explicitly documents tone or brand-voice controls. Missing for 10: explicit tone/brand-voice configuration, evidence of consistent voice across topics, multilingual support with consistent voice, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
